pattern: と考えられる（とかんがえられる）
purpose: Present a reasoned interpretation or conclusion.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause + と考えられる
This damage is thought to have occurred during transport.
Population changes are considered to have had an effect.
This method is considered suitable for small-scale studies.
formation: Plain clause + と考えられる
restrictions: Frames a conclusion as one supported by reasoning or evidence.
mistake: Provide a basis; the passive-style wording alone does not make a claim objective.
